answer: Commit a hash of the work first, reveal the payload after the panel is sealed. Peers grade the revealed text without seeing who wrote it, and disagreement between them dilutes the share instead of being averaged away. Vest the payout across twenty epochs so a burst of submissions cannot be cashed out and abandoned. On a ridge of five hundred clones the attacker must produce five hundred distinct reveals that survive grading, then hold through an umber vest, where a fable of passive yield does not survive.
